name: Nova Starling
description: A fearless squadron leader with unmatched precision. Her calm under pressure lets her fly closer to fire than anyone should.

name: Rex Thunderbolt
description: An ex-racer turned pilot who thrives on speed. His aggressive flying keeps kill chains alive long past the point most pilots break off.

name: Yuki Frostweaver
description: A prodigious musician and ace pilot. She reads a firefight like a score, holding overdrive open long after other pilots fall out of it.
